validation.scope: Each archived crop was matched to the nearest cosine-distance reference after excluding all crops with its scan ID. Counts and accuracy describe source-label agreement on this collection.
validation.grouping: A scan ID is inferred from the source label and filename. These IDs do not establish patient-level independence.
validation.distanceExplanation: Cosine distance is 1 minus cosine similarity in the ResNet50 feature space. The reference range comes from same-collection held-out crop comparisons. A larger distance means less resemblance to this index.
